entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse heart rate monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best assist, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a personal preference?
I... I think it's broken. The numbers seem all wrong, and it's just confusing to use. Honestly, it feels like a piece of garbage. I just want a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. That definitely sounds frustrating. In cases of a potential defect, our first step is to connect you with our technical support team. They can troubleshoot the issue with you and, if it's found to be faulty, they can authorize a warranty replacement right away.
Oh, I don't know about all that. That sounds complicated. I really don't have time to go through a bunch of steps over the phone. Can't you just help me? I just want my money back.
I understand you'd prefer a simple solution. Let me just pull up your order details. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 16 days ago, on January 4th. Is that correct?
Yes, I think so. So what does that mean?

I apologize, as this is where the policy can be a bit confusing. For most of our items, like jerseys, we have a 10-day return policy. However, for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, because it's a health device that syncs with personal data, we have a strict 10-day return window for a refund.
Ten days? No, that can't be right. I saw 10 days on the website. I'm so confused. This is all too much. I just want to send this thing back.

I truly apologize for the confusion on the website. You're right, our standard policy is 10 days, but this specific device has an exception due to hygiene protocols. Since we are on day 16, a return for a refund is no longer an option under that policy. The path forward would be through a warranty claim if the device is defective, which requires speaking with our tech team to verify the fault.
So you won't help me? I'm stuck with this thing that doesn't work? It really feels like you just want money and don't care if customers are happy. I don't understand what I'm supposed to do.

I assure you that's not the case, and I want to find a good solution for you. I can see from your account that you're a long-time VIP member with us, and we appreciate your loyalty. While I can't process the refund against policy, I can apologize for the policy confusion by offering you a $50 VeloFit store credit. You can use it on any future purchase, and it never expires. Would that be acceptable?
A store credit? I... I guess that's better than nothing. I'm still disappointed about the band.

I completely understand. I've just applied that $50 credit to your account. The offer to connect you with a senior tech specialist still stands if you change your mind. They really can make the process quite simple. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, I suppose that's it. Thank you for the credit, at least.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
